description: A0 lateral X decenter of the receiver
convergence_rule: double grid, <0.5% change in eta, checked at d=0 and d=tolerance for every gap
resample_after_refraction: False on all surfaces (no refracting surface in A0)

surface_settings._comment: Applied to the loaded model by python/alignment_sweep.py and read back. Beyond the Rayleigh range (51 um) the default POP propagator silently rescales its grid (window 0.08 -> 0.84 mm at 100 um gap); the angular-spectrum propagator keeps the stated window. eta is identical to ~1e-12 in both modes.

tolerance_method: cubic spline of loss(d), brentq root; both sides, mean reported

tolerance_conventions.rel: loss rises 1 dB above on-axis value (primary)
